paite: Huchi in Solomon in thu agen a, "TOUPA'N, mial bikbek ah ka om ding, achi a,
heading: Mipite Ma A Solomon Thugen / (1 Kum 8.12-21)
english: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

paite: himahleh na tenna ding, tangtawn a na omna ding inn ka hon lamsakta hi," chi in.
english: But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa akihei a, Israel kikhawm tengteng avualzawl a; Israel kikhawmte adingkhawm uhi.
english: The king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA Israel' Pathian, ka pa David kiang a amah kam mahmah a,
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan ka mi Israelte ka pikhiak ni a kipan Israelte nam lak a koi khua mah ka min omna ding inn lamna ding ka tel ngei kei a; ka mi Israelte tung a heutu ding mi kuamah ka tel ngei kei hi.
english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there, and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel;

paite: Himahleh, ka min omna ding in Jerusalem ka telta a, ka mi Israelte heutu ding in David ka tel hi, chi a genpa, amah khut mahmah a hon pichingsakpa phat in om hen.
english: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’

paite: "Ka pa David in Israel' Pathian, TOUPA min ding a inn lam angaihtuah hi.
english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N ka pa, David kiang ah, ka min ding a inn lam na ngaihtuah a, hichibang lungsim na na put na hihhoih hi; himahleh nang zaw inn na lam kei ding;
english: But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart;

paite: na tapa, na khal a hong pawt ding in ka min ding in inn ahon lam zaw ding, ana chita hi.
english: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

paite: "Huchi in TOUPA'N athugen atangtungsakta a: TOUPA chiamsa bang ngei in ka pa David mun ka hon luah a, Israel laltutphah ah ka hong tu a, Israel' Pathian TOUPA min ding inn ka hon lamta ahi.
english: “Yahweh has performed his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as Yahweh promised, and have built the house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Huai ah Israel suante kiang a na khun, TOUPA thukhun bawm ka koihta ahi," achi hi.
english: There I have set the ark, in which is Yahweh’s covenant, which he made with the children of Israel.”

paite: Huan TOUPA maitam bul ah Israel kikhawm tengteng muh in adingh a, aban azak a,
heading: Solomon Thumna / (1 Kum 8.22-53)
english: He stood before Yahweh’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands

paite: Solomon in dal dohkan asau lam tong nga, azatlam tong nga, asanlam tong thum a bawl huang laitak a tun tung ah atuang a, Israel kikhawm tengteng ma ah akhukdin a, van lam nga in aban azak a:
english: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the middle of the court; and he stood on it, and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven).

paite: "Aw TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, lei leh van ah nangmah bang mahmah Pathian a-om kei uh, alungtang tengteng ua na lampi tawnmi asikhate tung a thukhun tangtungsak a hehpihna kem,
english: Then he said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

paite: na sikha, ka pa David kiang a, na thuchiam na tangtungsak a; ahi, tuni in na kam a na gensa na khut in na lohchingsakta a:
english: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

paite: Huchi in aw TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, na sikha, ka pa David kiang a, na suante na om bang a om sam ding a-omdan ua apilvan peuhmah uleh, ka mitmuh a Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tasam kei ding, chi a na chiamsa tangtungsak in.
english: “Now therefore, Yahweh, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’

paite: Huchi in TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, na sikha, David kiang a na thugen lohchingsak mahmah in.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.

paite: "Himahleh, Pathian lei ah mihing lak ah a-om petmah dia hia? Ngai in, van, vante van ah leng na ta kei a, hiai ka inn lam ah ta kei sem na tel ni chia!
english: “But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house which I have built!

paite: Himahleh, aw TOUPA ka Pathian na sikha in nang ahon sapna leh athumna ngaihkhiaksak in, na sikha thumna leh ngetna hon limsak in.
english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and to his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you;

paite: Hiai mun lam nga a na sikha thumna ngaikhia a, huai ah ka min a-om ding, na chihna mun mahmah, inn lam ah sun leh zan a na mitsuan gige theihna ding in.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name, to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place.

paite: Na sikha leh na mi Israelte'n hiai mun lam nga a athum chiang un angetnate uh na ngaihkhiaksak zel in, ahi, na tenna mun van ah na ngaikhia inla, na zak chiang in ngaidam in.
english: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

paite: "Mi kuapeuh in a-invengte tung ah thil hihkhial in, kichiamsak hong kiphamoh taleh, hiai inn a na maitam ma ah hong kichiam henla;
english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

paite: nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, gamtang inla, migilou agitlouh man a moh tangsak in, midiktat adiktak man a dik tangsak in, na sikhate vai hawmsak in.
english: then hear from heaven, act, and judge your servants, bringing retribution to the wicked, to bring his way on his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

paite: "Na mi Israelte'n na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua melmate lak a avuallelh ua, nang lam ahong ngat nawn ua, na min agup ua, hiai inn a thum a thil na kiang a ahon nget uleh;
english: “If your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and they turn again and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house,

paite: nang van a pan na ngaihkhiaksak inla, na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, amau leh api-le-pute uh na piak gam ah pi nawn in.
english: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

paite: "Na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua van ahong bin a, vuah ahong zuk louh a, hiai mun lam nga a athum ua, na min agup uleh, amaute na hihgim ziak a akhelhna uh akisik uleh;
english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

paite: nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, apaina ding uh lampi hoih kawkmuh in na sikhate leh na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam in na mite agoutan ding ua na piakna gam ah vuah zusak in.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

paite: Ka gam ua kial ahong kiak a, hipi ahong len a, keuna hiam, muatna hiam, khaukhup hiam, lung hiam ahong om a, amelmate un akhuate uh ahong um ua, hipi bangpeuh, natna bangpeuh ahong tunleh hii avei uhiam, alungkhamna uh theipih in.
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is—

paite: Hiai inn lam nga a ban zak a mimal hiam, Israel mipihon in hiam thumna leh ngetna ahon tut uh:
english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house,

paite: Na omna van a pan na ngaikhia inla, ngaidam inla, michih a-omdan bang chiat un lohchingsak in, alungtang uh lah na thei ngal a; nangmah kia mihing tate lungtang theipa na hi.
english: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men),

paite: Ka pi-le-pute uh na piak gam a a-om sung teng ua na lampi tawn thei ding a nang laudan ahong siamna ding un.
english: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

paite: "Na mi Israelte hilou, namdangmi, na min thupitak leh na khut hattak leh na ban zak ziak a gam gamlatak a kipan a hong pai, hiai inn lam nga a ahong thum chiang un:
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes from a far country for your great name’s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,

paite: Nang na omna van ah na ngaikhia inla, nang hon sapdan uh dungzui in namdangte tung ah leng hih in, huchi in na mi Israelte bangmah in leitung a mi tengteng in na min athei ding ua, nang laudan ahong siam ding ua, hiai ka inn lam in na min apu chih athei ding uhi.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

paite: "Na mite'n amelmate uh na sawlna lamlam a asual ua na khopi tel leh na min omna dia na lam inn lam nga a na kiang a athum uleh:
english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you send them, and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;

paite: Nang athumna uh leh angetna uh van a pan na ngaikhia inla, athu uah pi zel in.
english: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

paite: "Na tung a ahong khelh ua, kuamah lah khial lou a-om ngal kei a, atung ua na heh a, melma khut a na piak a, gam gamlapi ah hiam, naideuh ah hiam sal a api un leng,
english: “If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near;

paite: sal a apina gam ua akingaihtuahkhiak ua, akisik ua, 'I na khialta, dikloutak leh gitlouhhuaitak in thil i na hihta,' chi a atanna gam ua ngetna ahon tut ua;
english: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’

paite: sal a amau apina ua, atanna gam ua alungtangtak uleh alungsim taktak ua nang lam ahong ngat ua, api-le-pute uh gam lam leh na khopi tel leh na min dia ka lam inn lam nga a na kiang a athum uleh;
english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land which you gave to their fathers, and the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name;

paite: athumna uh leh angetna uh nang na omna van ah na ngaikhia inla, athu uah pi zel inla, na tung a na khialta na mite ngaidam in.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

paite: "Aw ka Pathian, hehpih in na mit hong hak inla, hiai mun athumna ah na bildoh in.
english: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

paite: Aw TOUPA Pathian, na omna mun ah paitou in nang leh na hatna bawm toh, Aw TOUPA Pathian, na siampute na hotdamna in van inla, na misiangthoute hoihna in nuamsasak in.
english: “Now therefore arise, Yahweh God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, Yahweh God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

paite: Aw TOUPA Pathian, na thaunilhpa mel lehngatsan ke'nla, na sikha David thil hoih hihte theigige in," achi hi.
english: “Yahweh God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”
